title: Official Metadata Addon TMDB IMDb Find Lookup
problem: TMDB currently uses native TMDB query IDs for direct lookup, but query IMDb IDs still fall through to ambiguous title search even though TMDB supports official find-by-IMDb lookup.
gates: cargo nextest run -p nako-metadata-scraper tmdb ranking title --no-fail-fast

continue_policy.notes: Lane complete. TMDB IMDb find keeps trying later valid IMDb IDs before title-search fallback, normalizes case-varied IMDb IDs to lowercase tt, and deduplicates repeated normalized IDs before external requests. Follow-ons include richer TMDB find disambiguation if needed, live TMDB drift checks with credentials, or analogous cross-provider ID lookup for another provider.
